Record Class PyprojectModel.TestResources

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.pyronaut.config.model.PyprojectModel.TestResources
Record Components:
configured - whether the testResources table is explicitly present in pyproject.toml
enabled - whether standalone test resources server support is enabled
version - requested test-resources tooling version
explicitPort - explicit server port (otherwise ephemeral)
inferClasspath - infer launcher classpath from runtime
additionalModules - additional test resources modules
clientTimeout - client timeout in seconds
sharedServer - use shared server settings path under user home
sharedServerNamespace - namespace suffix for shared server settings directory
logsDir - directory for test resources server logs
serverIdleTimeoutMinutes - idle timeout before server self-shutdown
serverSystemProperties - JVM system properties passed to server process
serverEnvironment - environment variables passed to server process
debugServer - enable server debug mode
javaExecutable - explicit Java executable for server process
startupOptimization - startup optimization mode (none/auto/leyden/cds)
leydenJvmArgs - Leyden JVM args used for best-effort startup optimization
Enclosing class:
PyprojectModel
